meta.note: The Temporal Kernel Specification — constitutional foundation.

axioms: Temporal Primacy: time is the primary resource; all else is subordinate to the timeline
Causal Determinism: every state is the atomic result of a preceding causal event
Physical Sovereignty: abstractions must never hide physical reality; resources are finite and explicitly allocated
seven_pillars: Object Model: everything is a uniquely identified, time-bounded Object
Capability System: authority via time-anchored, delegatable Leases
Thread Lifecycle: execution streams exist only while they hold Temporal Credits
Scheduling Model: deterministic arbitration by the Temporal Manifold
Pager Protocol: memory as negotiated territory with explicit TTLs
The Contract: the kernel is supreme arbitrator of the laws of existence
integrity: Temporal Isolation: a failure in one object cannot violate another's timeline or territory. Foundation of Sovereign Hosting.
system_role: Constitutional foundation for the whole engine: time-first, causal, finite. The Alchemedies fluid medium obeys these axioms.
